revisions.content: An original premium cut-paper style colored clipart: ONE friendly russet-brown spider positioned ABOVE a small orange camping lantern. Dorsal overhead view, two oval body segments, friendly tiny eyes at the lower end. Exactly eight walking legs: four on LEFT, four on RIGHT, symmetrically spaced in four pairs and completely separated. The empty lantern sits below the spider with visible space between them, dark glass panes and a metal handle. Smooth opaque painted color shapes, crisp dark ink outlines, warm clean cel shading. Detailed feet joints and lantern hardware, broad stylized fur patterns. Entire complete artwork centered with wide margins. Every space outside the object contours and between all limbs is fully transparent alpha. No lettering.

Create a NEW professional clipart in the crisp opaque storybook finish of the reference. Use only the illustration quality and transparent cutout style; do not reuse the leaf, droplet, spider pose or pattern. New scene: a friendly chocolate-brown spider with exactly eight clearly separated walking legs, four each side, next to a small CLOSED orange lantern with DARK glass. Spider on right and small lantern on left, no objects overlap limbs. Two body segments and small friendly eyes. Smooth broad color planes, detailed deliberate ink contours and simple fur tufts. Fully transparent canvas and gaps, opaque object silhouettes with crisp edges. All objects fit well within the canvas. No background atmosphere or illumination.

Remove the background completely. Keep only the spider and the lantern. Erase the brown aura everywhere, including between legs and inside the lantern handle. Make all empty areas fully transparent, with sharp clean cutout edges. Preserve the objects exactly.
